opportunities.name: Postgraduate Studentship (PGS)
eligibility_clues: Financial support for full-time research postgraduate MPhil and PhD students
Up to 2 years for full-time MPhil students and up to 4 years for full-time PhD students
No separate application; suitability is considered with the research postgraduate application
Based on academic merit, including English language proficiency, and suitability for the programme
Recipients act as Graduate Teaching Assistants; the award is not described as taxable employment income
Local and non-local full-time research postgraduate students are both in the studentship rules
Department of Mathematics says current PhD and MPhil students have been on full financial support covering a living stipend
Mathematics PhD research areas include Applied Mathematics; MPhil students may take the Scientific Computation concentration
A higher rate after the PhD qualifying examination is possible, subject to department or supervisor top-up; that higher rate is not printed
opportunities.amount_note: Printed on the FYTGS scholarships and fees page as HK$ 229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year). The School of Science admissions page for this intake prints HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420 per year). Neither page prints a monthly rate. The Mathematics financial-support page does not print a dollar amount.
opportunities.deadline_note: The cited scholarships-and-fees page does not print a PGS deadline. The 2027/28 Mathematics catalog prints 1 Jun 2027 for local full-time applicants. That catalog date was not copied onto this source_url.
opportunities.match_rationale: This is the university postgraduate studentship for full-time MPhil and PhD study, and Mathematics includes applied and computational mathematics. Local students are eligible, and the 2027/28 round is open. The printed value is an annual figure; a monthly rate was not on the pages that loaded.
opportunities.intake_relevance: 2027/28 Fall applications are open. Mathematics local full-time deadline printed as 1 Jun 2027, rolling.
restrictions: PGS is suspended during university-approved employment

opportunities.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
eligibility_clues: HKUST is inviting applications for 2027/28
PhD studies only
Applicants are expected to show outstanding academic records, research ability, international exposure, communication skills, and leadership
HKUST lists Hong Kong among the places of origin of awardees
RGC page says applicants from all over who seek admission as a new full-time PhD student in a Hong Kong university may apply
RGC shortlisting includes a Sciences, Medicine, Engineering, and Technology panel
Package on the HKUST page also includes a tuition waiver for 4 years, HKUST RedBird PhD Award, and conference travel allowance
Candidates who are not selected may be considered for PhD admission with Postgraduate Studentship, HKUST Redbird PhD Award, and a waiver of tuition fee in the first year
opportunities.amount_note: HKUST HKPFS page also prints a waiver of tuition fees for 4 years, Recruitment Award of HK$ 40,000 (~US$5,130) in the first year, Academic Excellence Award of HK$ 20,000 (~US$2,560) per year in the following years, and Conference Travel Allowance of HK$ 14,400 (~US$1,850) per year for 4 years. The RGC page prints HK$344,400 and HK$14,400 as 2026/27 figures for up to three years, and says universities may provide additional support after three years. The FYTGS other-funding page prints an HKPFS conference travel allowance of HK$14,200.
opportunities.deadline_note: RGC initial application: 1 Dec 2026 (12noon, GMT+8). HKUST full application: 1 Dec 2026 (11:59pm, GMT+8). The HKUST page says successful candidates will be notified by RGC via email in May 2027.
opportunities.match_rationale: The cited page lists Hong Kong among awardee places of origin, prints an annual stipend, and says the 2027/28 application is open. A local PhD applicant can be considered. The scheme is PhD-only.
opportunities.intake_relevance: 2027/28 round is open, with HKUST and RGC deadlines on 1 December 2026.

opportunities.name: Tuition Waiver Scheme for Local Research Postgraduate Students
eligibility_clues: Full-time UGC-funded MPhil or PhD
Category I, including a Hong Kong permanent identity card
Also covers right to land, right of abode, unconditional stay, a one-way permit, or a qualifying dependent visa with a residency test
For 2027/28 the residency requirement is set at one year; two years applies from 2028/29
Normative period: MPhil 2 years; PhD with a research master's degree 3 years; PhD without a research master's degree 4 years
No separate application
Students receiving PGS or HKPFS are eligible
Students whose tuition is fully waived by another scheme are not eligible
opportunities.amount_note: The scholarships and fees page prints Tuition Waiver of HK$ 49,500 p.a. and says tuition fees are subject to annual review. The same page lists research postgraduate tuition as HK$47,000 (full-time/part-time). The dedicated waiver page says eligible students are not required to pay the tuition and does not print a dollar amount. The School of Science page also prints Tuition Waiver of HK$49,500 p.a.
opportunities.deadline_note: No separate application is required. No application deadline is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: A Hong Kong permanent resident in full-time Mathematics MPhil or PhD study is in the eligible local group for 2027/28. This waives tuition and is not a monthly living stipend.
opportunities.intake_relevance: The page states a one-year residency transition for the 2027/28 academic year. Waiver applies during the normative study period after enrolment.
restrictions: Full-time UGC-funded MPhil or PhD only
Not available when another scheme already waives tuition in full
